_comment: Canonical per-canton salary index for Switzerland. Single source of truth consumed by BOTH the .mjs estimation pipeline (scripts/lib/swiss-canton-salary.mjs) and the .ts SEO build (build-plugins/shared/cantonSalaryIndex.ts). A drift guard test (tests/swiss-canton-salary-parity.test.ts) locks the two TS/MJS accessors to this file.
_methodology: BFS does NOT publish per-canton wage medians for free; the LSE (Lohnstrukturerhebung) sample is only large enough for the 7 official Grossregionen. The defensible official-source approach: each canton inherits the median of its Grossregion, and the Ticino USTAT sector structure (sector x level shape, p25/p75 spread, frontalieri ratio) is scaled by factor = grossregionMedian / ticinoMedian. Ticino factor = 1.0 -> Ticino estimates are byte-identical to the prior model. The frontalieri (cross-border) wage discount is applied only to border cantons, where Permit G commuters actually work; interior cantons use the full resident median (no discount).

_sources.grossregionMedian2024: BFS STAT-TAB cube px-x-0304010000_203 (LSE 2024), gross monthly wage, central value, FTE standardized to 4 1/3 weeks, private+public sector. https://www.pxweb.bfs.admin.ch/pxweb/de/px-x-0304010000_203/ — machine-verified via PX-Web JSON API.
_sources.grossregionMapping: BFS NUTS-2 Grandes regions / Grossregionen standard (official cube metadata labels).
_sources.minimumWage: Cantonal statutory minimum wage laws (GE OCIRT, NE/JU/BS/TI cantonal sites). 2026 hourly rates annualized at 2080 h/year (40 h x 52 w) to match the existing Ticino convention. BS conservative (sources conflict 21.00 vs 22.20 CHF/h — verify against BS Mindestlohngesetz before raising).
_sources.frontalieri: BFS STAF Grenzgaengerstatistik (px-x-0302010000) — canton-level presence of cross-border workers. https://www.bfs.admin.ch/bfs/de/home/statistiken/arbeit-erwerb/erhebungen/ggs.html
_sources.nationalMedian2024: BFS LSE 2024 national median gross monthly wage.
